Child stories created (dependency chain S1 -> S2 -> S3 -> S4):
- S1 trivial-americium-motmot (4183-cd0a-8407-49fd): twelve ticket-verb merges + `_REMOVED_SPELLINGS` registry.
- S2 cubistic-patrician-deer (fea5-698b-d585-40c4): `rebar store` group, depends on S1.
- S3 scabby-loverless-pipit (3e7a-d8ef-ce56-4eb7): ungated docs, release notes, CHANGELOG, ADR 0117, depends on S2.
- S4 idling-amaranth-antelope (2183-fa68-d48f-42fe): held-out drift test, depends on S3.

Cross-epic note on `src/rebar/_cli/_help_route.py`: S1 turns the frozensets at `:49-55` into the `_REMOVED_SPELLINGS` dict. The config/env epic's alias-machinery story and the overlap epic's `_intercepts()` removal do not touch that file, so there is no shared-line conflict; if a later epic retires another verb it adds one dict entry there.

ADR number claimed by this epic: 0117 (CLI verb consolidation). The MCP-derivation epic claims 0118; the reconciler epic claims 0119.
